races.name: Drain Detectives Handicap

runners_data.name: Head Girl
runners_data.note: Prominent runner whose seasonal debut disappointment may have needed the run after 33 days off
runners_data.comment: Unexposed after only four runs but finished down the field on seasonal/handicap debut
runners_data.spotlight: Unexposed after only four runs but was unable to justify prominence in betting when down the field on last month's seasonal/handicap debut at Wolverhampton (1m4f, AW); needs a good boost from the new cheekpieces.

runners_data.name: Timely Salute
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with concerning fade pattern who needs the step up in trip to be effective
runners_data.comment: Soundly beaten in both handicaps; significant improvement needed over new trip here
runners_data.spotlight: Soundly beaten in both handicaps, more recently when last of nine at Bath (1m2f, firm; Lucky Sevens finished second) this month; bred to be suited by this longer trip but needs significant improvement.

runners_data.name: Mick The Hat
runners_data.note: Hold-up type from top yard making significant trip increase which should suit his breeding
runners_data.comment: Safely held in all three qualifying races but should be more competitive on handicap debut
runners_data.spotlight: Beaten at least 12l in his three qualifying races (1m-8.6f), showing nothing more than glimmers of promise, but moves up in trip here and ought to be much more competitive in this low-grade handicap.

runners_data.name: Panthere Noir
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner showing improvement and carrying useful 7lb claim from improving apprentice
runners_data.comment: Belied 50-1 odds when third at Windsor last week and remains unexposed over this trip
runners_data.spotlight: 13-race maiden; bettered low-key stable debut and belied 50-1 odds when third of 14 at Windsor (11.4f, good to firm; refitted cheekpieces) one week ago; still unexposed over this sort of trip; a possible.

runners_data.name: Ada Rose
runners_data.note: Sole front runner whose trip increase transformed her form last time and faces no pace pressure
runners_data.comment: Improved form when placed on last month's handicap debut (1m4f, AW); turf debut today
runners_data.spotlight: Evidently suited by big hike up in trip (from 7f) when third of 11 on last month's handicap debut at Wolverhampton (1m4f, AW); that run came after a break and she could easily have more to offer if handling switch to turf.

runners_data.name: Song Of The Stars
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse making turf debut in cheekpieces with solid recent Wolverhampton third
runners_data.comment: Safely held when third on AW this month and now 0-6; more needed on turf debut
runners_data.spotlight: Safely held when third in first-time cheekpieces (retained) at Wolverhampton (1m4f, AW) three weeks ago and now 0-6; needs to find something extra on this turf debut.

runners_data.name: Keep It Classic
runners_data.note: Prominent runner unlucky last time who raced too keenly but has clear recent improvement
runners_data.comment: Went close at Haydock this month and might settle better with headgear left off here
runners_data.spotlight: Still a maiden after six starts but lost out only by a short head over similar trip to today's at Haydock (good; wore cheekpieces) three weeks ago, despite racing too freely; might be more relaxed with the headgear left off here; respected.

runners_data.name: Fletcher
runners_data.note: Hold-up type who raced lazily last time but showed scope and gets longer trip
runners_data.comment: Just a respectable fourth on seasonal/handicap debut (1m2f) but has scope to build on that
runners_data.spotlight: Raced rather lazily and finished about 6l behind Lucky Sevens when fourth on last month's seasonal/handicap debut at Yarmouth (1m2f, good) but has obvious scope to build on that performance over this longer trip.

runners_data.name: Mister Pretentious
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner making handicap debut with no significant form to recommend
runners_data.comment: Showed no significant promise when a 250-1 outsider for his three qualifying races
runners_data.spotlight: Showed no significant promise when a 250-1 outsider for his three qualifying races (1m-1m2f) and makes handicap debut from out of the weights; upped in trip with cheekpieces added.

runners_data.name: Naranka
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who was always behind last week and needs major improvement from that effort
runners_data.comment: Always behind when 50-1 for seasonal debut a week ago
runners_data.spotlight: Always behind when 50-1 for seasonal debut at Windsor (11.4f, good to firm; Panthere Noir third) one week ago; needs to have taken considerable benefit from that outing.

runners_data.name: Lucky Sevens
runners_data.note: Hold-up type with recent win and placed efforts whose style suits this tactical scenario
runners_data.comment: Placed twice over 1m2f since last month's 1m win; upped in trip again here; big player
runners_data.spotlight: Opened account when fitted with cheekpieces for turf debut at Yarmouth (1m, good to firm) last month and was placed over 1m2f on both starts since, more recently when clear second to much-improved rival at Bath (firm); upped in trip again here; leading contender.

runners_data.name: Out In The Cold
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner trying cheekpieces and trip increase but has shown little impact in handicaps
runners_data.comment: Unable to land a telling blow off basement marks in her first three handicaps
runners_data.spotlight: Unable to land a telling blow off basement marks in her first three handicaps (1m-1m2f); moves up in trip and tries cheekpieces here.

races.paceDynamic: Ada Rose is the only confirmed front runner and should get an uncontested lead in this 12-runner field. With Head Girl and Keep It Classic the only prominent racers, there's minimal early pressure, allowing Ada Rose to dictate fractions. The majority of the field consists of hold-up horses including Lucky Sevens, Panthere Noir, Song Of The Stars, Fletcher, and Naranka, creating a strong kick finish from the back. This sustainable pace setup strongly favours hold-up horses who can unleash late runs.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Lead Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Ada Rose gets soft fractions and stays strong
scenarios.body: Ada Rose faces minimal early pressure and maintains enough energy to resist the late charge. The lack of pace pressure allows the leader to control the race completely.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Swamp
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is too slow for the closers
scenarios.body: The gentle early pace sets up a sprint finish where multiple hold-up horses produce telling late runs. Lucky Sevens and Panthere Noir benefit most from the tactical setup.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Trackers Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Head Girl or Keep It Classic track perfectly
scenarios.body: The prominent runners get ideal positioning behind Ada Rose and kick before the hold-up horses can get organized. Keep It Classic's recent near-miss form makes this scenario viable.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Ada Rose goes too slow early
scenarios.body: The fractions become crawling and turn into a pure sprint where any horse can win from anywhere. This chaotic finish could suit an outsider getting a dream run.

watchPoints.text: Ada Rose setting crawling fractions early could turn this into a cavalry charge finish
Lucky Sevens and Fletcher getting cover in midfield positions before making their moves
Keep It Classic's early positioning - needs to settle better than recent keen tendencies
Panthere Noir and Song Of The Stars for market support given their recent improvements
Christian Howarth's 3lb claim helping Lucky Sevens carry top weight effectively

races.name: Drain Detectives Premier Drainage Company Handicap

runners_data.name: Crafter
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning to turf after three years, regressive form and career-low mark makes him hard to fancy despite trainer's recent winner.
runners_data.comment: In fair form on AW but regressive and is having his first turf run in three years
runners_data.spotlight: Winless since 2024 and is having his first run on turf in three years; down to a career-low mark and has been in fair form in blinkers, but he's regressive and has returned three poor efforts in turf handicaps.

runners_data.name: Pride Of Nepal
runners_data.note: Front runner with clear tactical advantage, won easily at Windsor last week and can control this race from the front without pressure.
runners_data.comment: Happier on turf; leading claims back up 6lb for last weekend's easy Windsor win
runners_data.spotlight: Frequent slow starter who was the biggest price of his trainer's three runners when winning easily at Windsor (1m2f, good to firm) last Saturday, without the usual tongue-tie/cheekpieces, as today; had looked on the downgrade on the AW but happier on turf; leading claims back up 6lb.

runners_data.name: Haveagobeau
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with dual Polytrack wins here this year but 0-19 on turf, needs luck in running from back of field.
runners_data.comment: Didn't look to have any excuses back on turf (now 0-19) off this mark early in the month
runners_data.spotlight: Dual Polytrack winner here this year, latterly in 0-50 company; didn't look to have any excuses back on turf (now 0-19) off this mark early in the month and needs more.

runners_data.name: Twilight Guest
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who won hat-trick at Brighton last year so handles the track, but poor recent form suggests he's regressed.
runners_data.comment: Notched a hat-trick this time last year; string of poor efforts since though
runners_data.spotlight: Landed hat-trick this time last year, including two round Brighton, so this track won't be a concern; a string of poor efforts since, though, including when beaten a long way behind Pride Of Nepal at Windsor last week.

runners_data.name: Cezarro
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who's been expensive to follow lately, headgear removed tonight which could be positive or negative signal.
runners_data.comment: Expensive to follow on the AW this spring; below par back on turf ten days ago
runners_data.spotlight: Regressive, ex-Irish maiden who's been expensive to follow on the AW this spring; below par back in headgear (left off tonight) on his return to turf ten days ago.

runners_data.name: Duke Orsino
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with better effort at Yarmouth over this trip last time, suited by step up in distance but needs strong pace.
runners_data.spotlight: One of his better efforts at Yarmouth one month ago, when going beyond 1m for the first time, but was probably flattered in a muddling, small-field affair; will want to settle better upped in distance again.

runners_data.name: Stoneacre
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse and poor maiden who's never been competitive, blinkers replacing cheekpieces unlikely to transform him.
runners_data.comment: Poor maiden who's never gone close to finishing placed (7f-1m6f); blinkers no help latest
runners_data.spotlight: Poor maiden who's never gone close to finishing placed (7f-1m6f); the switch from cheekpieces to blinkers didn't make any difference back on turf one month ago.

runners_data.name: Shifra
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with poor form under both codes, has tendency to fade in finish which is concerning in weak field.
runners_data.comment: Poor under both codes; hard to make a case for her, even in such a weak handicap
runners_data.spotlight: Poor under both codes, again starting a big price back on the Flat five weeks ago; hard to make a case for her, even in such a weak handicap.

races.paceDynamic: Pride Of Nepal is the only confirmed front runner in this 8-runner field, giving him a significant tactical advantage to dictate terms from the front without pressure. The rest are all hold-up horses who will need to come from behind, creating a bunched field that will rely on Pride Of Nepal's pace judgment. With no prominent racers to apply early pressure, Pride Of Nepal can control fractions and kick when it suits him best. This race shape strongly favours the front runner and any horse with early pace who can track the leader closely.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Pride Controls Uncontested
scenarios.trigger: If Pride Of Nepal breaks cleanly and establishes an early lead without pressure
scenarios.body: He can dictate conservative fractions and has plenty left for the finish, while the hold-up brigade gets bunched up behind with limited room to manoeuvre. The lack of pace pressure allows him to time his effort perfectly.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Slow Early Burn
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes crawling with all hold-up horses sitting too far back
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where the best turn of foot wins, favouring horses with recent good form who can quicken. Pride Of Nepal gets swamped by superior finishing speed in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Traffic Problems Decide
scenarios.trigger: If the field bunches up turning for home with multiple hold-up horses seeking the same gaps
scenarios.body: Clear running becomes crucial and the horse with the best position or luck in running prevails. Those drawn wide or getting first run have major advantages over those trapped behind the wall of hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pride Stops Dramatically
scenarios.trigger: If Pride Of Nepal sets unsustainably fast fractions or ties up badly in the final quarter
scenarios.body: Any hold-up horse with a decent turn of foot can pick up the pieces as the leader capitulates. The winner emerges from the pack as Pride Of Nepal falls away rapidly.

watchPoints.text: Pride Of Nepal breaking slowly would completely change the race dynamic and leave no obvious pace angle.
Traffic problems are highly likely with seven hold-up horses all needing the same late gaps in the straight.
Watch for any hold-up horse showing early pace to track Pride Of Nepal closely rather than dropping out the back.
The betting market - if Pride Of Nepal drifts significantly it could signal stable confidence issues after last week's win.
Cezarro running without headgear for the first time in recent runs could indicate trainer expects improved effort.

races.name: Drain Detectives CCTV Drain Surveys Handicap

runners_data.name: Epictetus
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse facing significant traffic problems with five others adopting similar tactics behind a likely uncontested leader
runners_data.comment: Found his level again but wants a good test over this trip and hasn't won in a long time
runners_data.spotlight: Things didn't pan out his way on first crack at 1m4f here last time (AW) and that was another in-form effort; has found his level again but wants a good test over this trip, he hasn't won in a long time and has become inconsistent on turf.

runners_data.name: Quamby
runners_data.note: Prominent racer who tends to over-race but benefits from the likely strong early gallop and Jamie Spencer's restraint
runners_data.comment: Inclined to over-race on comeback from five months off and entitled to improve; considered
runners_data.spotlight: Maiden who missed a lot of last year but has returned a string of solid efforts in defeat, including in handicap company the past twice; inclined to over-race on her comeback from five months off and is entitled to improve; considered.

runners_data.name: Hitched
runners_data.note: Hold-up style after 57-day break makes this a tough assignment against pace-favoring conditions
runners_data.comment: Much higher in the weights than when last seen frequently on turf; tough task
runners_data.spotlight: A regular on the AW here (three wins) who's much higher in the weights than when last seen frequently on turf; generally consistent but whether he's up to this mark on grass is the leading question, and Quamby looks his trainer's best chance.

runners_data.name: Red Hat Eagle
runners_data.note: First-time cheekpieces may sharpen him but hold-up style faces tactical disadvantage in this small field
runners_data.spotlight: Has not run badly in two starts back from around 18 months off but has never been quite this far before; goes in first-time cheekpieces (worn a hood twice before) back from ten weeks off.

runners_data.name: Sweet Reward
runners_data.note: Prominent racer with Olivia Tubb's 5lb claim perfectly suited to tracking Post Rider's expected lead
runners_data.comment: Yard enjoying a good spring; 7lb rise for her recent win over 1m2f will test her
runners_data.spotlight: Generally kept away from fast ground but won easily on good to firm over 1m2f here for Olivia Tubb early in the month; retains most of her ability for a yard enjoying a good spring but she's often come to hand early in the past and a 7lb rise will test her.

runners_data.name: Post Rider
runners_data.note: Lone front-runner returning from 159-day break but has strong record fresh and should get uncontested lead
runners_data.comment: Resumes on a career-high mark and she'll need to be spot on; may be the one to lead
runners_data.spotlight: Her wins after breaks of three months and four months are a positive as she returns from a layoff; resumes on a career-high mark, though, having closed out last year with a second on Tapeta, and she'll need to be spot on to win this; may be the one to lead.

runners_data.name: Footwork
runners_data.note: Progressive prominent racer in career-best form who can benefit from tracking the early leaders throughout
runners_data.comment: Holds decent claims under 3lb claimer Jack Callan (10-44 for yard) upped 3lb for Ayr win
runners_data.spotlight: Progressed during a light campaign last season and turned in a career-best effort over this trip for the first time at Ayr (good to firm) ten days ago; holds decent claims upped 3lb under 3lb claimer Jack Callan, who's enjoying a fine season and is 10-44 for the yard.

races.paceDynamic: Post Rider will be the sole early leader with Sweet Reward and Quamby tracking in second and third positions, creating a manageable gallop over the opening mile. The lack of pace pressure means Post Rider can dictate terms without being harassed, while the prominent trio of Sweet Reward, Quamby and Footwork will stalk within striking distance turning for home. With five of seven runners adopting hold-up tactics, this sets up perfectly for the pace-setters and prominent racers who can avoid the inevitable traffic problems that will engulf the backmarkers. This race shape strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Lead Pays
scenarios.trigger: If Post Rider gets an easy time in front without early pressure...
scenarios.body: Post Rider can kick clear turning for home before the hold-up brigade get organized, while Sweet Reward and Footwork benefit from tracking the winner throughout. The five hold-up horses will struggle to make up ground against runners who never lost touch with the pace.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes just quick enough to stretch Post Rider's stamina reserves...
scenarios.body: Sweet Reward or Footwork can pounce from their stalking positions as Post Rider weakens in the final furlong. The hold-up horses still face the same traffic issues but one may find a clean run to grab third.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Charge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace collapses completely and becomes crawling slow...
scenarios.body: The superior class of Epictetus or Red Hat Eagle can overcome their hold-up styles as the race becomes a sprint. Post Rider and the prominent runners lose their tactical advantage when the race turns into a dash.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Post Rider refuses to go forward or breaks slowly from the gates...
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy affair with no clear pace-setter, allowing any horse with tactical speed to steal a march. Quamby's prominent style could prove decisive if he can grab an unexpected lead.

watchPoints.text: Post Rider breaking slowly or refusing to take up the running would completely alter the race dynamic
Sweet Reward over-racing early after her recent easy win could compromise her finishing kick
The five hold-up horses bunching together turning for home creating traffic nightmares
Quamby's tendency to over-race against the likely strong early gallop set by Post Rider
Red Hat Eagle's first-time cheekpieces potentially making him more keen than usual early

races.name: APC Electrical EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Alta Regina
runners_data.comment: 240,000gns breeze-up 2yo who's bred to be sharp; the market will assist
runners_data.spotlight: 80,000gns yearling, 240,000gns breeze-up 2yo who's bred to be sharp, being out of a 2yo 5f winner and a half-sister to two 2yo winners, one on debut; trainer 7-23 with juveniles on turf (this is his first 2yo runner of the season) and she's an interesting newcomer.

runners_data.name: Blue Sign
runners_data.comment: April-foaled 32,000gns yearling, £50,000 breeze-up 2yo; may want more of a test
runners_data.spotlight: April-foaled 32,000gns yearling, £50,000 breeze-up 2yo who's a half-sister to two 1m AW winners; trainer, who's had a big-priced 2yo win on debut this spring, has a better record with juveniles on the AW and she may want more of a test in due course.

runners_data.name: Glamorize
runners_data.comment: Late-foaled £48,000 yearling, £155,000 breeze-up 2yo; yard 4-12 with 2yos this season
runners_data.spotlight: Late-foaled £48,000 yearling, £155,000 breeze-up 2yo; yard among the winners and is an excellent 4-12 with 2yos this season (two winning on debut); in the same ownership as George Boughey's pair and the market will doubtless tell a tale.

runners_data.name: Roxa Love
runners_data.comment: 100,000gns yearling who's a half-sister to Natural Force, who won on 2yo debut; handy draw
runners_data.spotlight: 100,000gns yearling who's a half-sister to Natural Force, who won on 2yo debut, and Mademoiselle, plus three other lesser lights; well drawn on debut (next to stablemate Queencard).

runners_data.name: Targa
runners_data.comment: Very slowly away on debut last weekend, so that can be ignored, but she was easy to back
runners_data.spotlight: £105,000 breeze-up 2yo whose trainer has enjoyed a good spring with juveniles; it was game over at the stalls on her Goodwood debut last weekend (very slowly away), so that can be ignored, but she was easy to back and it's possible she'll repeat the dose.

runners_data.name: Queencard
runners_data.comment: Plenty of pace before cracking late over Newmarket's 6f on debut; her claims are obvious
runners_data.spotlight: 200,000gns yearling who's out of Norfolk Stakes winner Shang Shang Shang; showed plenty of pace before cracking late over Newmarket's 6f on debut and her claims are obvious dropping back in trip from a handy draw.

runners_data.name: Charcoal Diva
runners_data.comment: Started a three-figure price when beaten a long way on her Yarmouth debut recently
runners_data.spotlight: 3,000gns yearling who started a three-figure price when beaten a long way on her Yarmouth debut recently; needs a big step forward.

runners_data.name: Matriarchal
runners_data.comment: Needs more under a penalty as she becomes her trainer's first runner outside Ireland
runners_data.spotlight: On the go early and put her experience to good use when making all on rain-softened ground at Navan a fortnight ago; needs more under a penalty (experienced Harry Vigors taking off 7lb will help) as she becomes her trainer's first runner outside Ireland.

races.name: Free Race Replays On attheraces.com EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (Bands B, C & D) (Qualifier) (GBB)

runners_data.name: Solar Maximus
runners_data.comment: Out of a Listed-placed 5f 2yo winner from a top sprinting family; appeals on paper
runners_data.spotlight: 50,000gns yearling; fifth foal; half-brother to winners Brassica (Listed-placed 7.4f 2yo; RPR 96) and Von Baer (7f; 91); dam Listed-placed 5f 2yo winner (88), half-sister to 6f Group 1 winner Dream Of Dreams, family of top sprinter Airwave; looks the part on paper.

runners_data.name: Able Tasman
runners_data.comment: Bred for longer trips than this but stable's first-time-out 2yos are usually of interest
runners_data.spotlight: 46,000euros yearling; tenth foal; closely related to 9.4f-2m winner Antiquarium (RPR 112), half-brother to three winners including Grand Scheme (1m-1m6f; 92); dam 1m4f AW winner (76), half-sister to smart 1m2f-1m6f winner Scott's View; will probably need longer trips to be seen to best effect but first-time-out 2yos from this stable are usually of interest.

runners_data.name: Pj's Corner
runners_data.comment: Dam unraced half-sister to a Listed-placed 5f winner; stable not prolific with newcomers
runners_data.spotlight: £30,000 yearling; second foal; half-brother to 5f AW winner Houndhill (RPR 72); dam unraced sister to Listed-placed 5f winner Lokada; stable has only occasional first-time-out 2yo winners.

runners_data.name: Gliding Martha
runners_data.comment: Out of half-sister to two Group 3 sprint winners; would be rare winning newcomer for yard
runners_data.spotlight: 40,000gns yearling; fourth foal; half-sister to 1m1f winner Loveable Rogue (RPR 72); dam runner-up 5f-1m (75), half-sister to Group 3 winners Burnt Sugar (6f 2yo) and Brown Sugar (5f/6f 2yo); would be a rare winning newcomer for the stable.

runners_data.name: Nakila Sun
runners_data.comment: Out of unraced sister to German 7f 2yo Group 3 winner; in good hands; market may guide
runners_data.spotlight: 8,000euros yearling; fourth foal; dam unraced sister to German 7f 2yo Group 3 winner Navarra King, out of an Italian 1m2f Group 3 winner; in good hands; market may guide.

runners_data.name: Wadima
runners_data.spotlight: First foal; dam 9.4f AW winner (RPR 71), half-sister to 7f winner Zabeir, out of unraced half-sister to Listed winners Zanughan (1m4f) and Zand (10.5f); worth a glance in the betting.

runners_data.name: Sword Salute
runners_data.comment: Promising debut when third at Redcar 12 days ago (winner could be smart)
runners_data.spotlight: Out of a very useful 7f/1m winner and made promising debut when third of seven at Redcar (7f, good; winner could be smart) 12 days ago; already sets a fairly good standard and improvement is likely.

runners_data.name: Sakowin
runners_data.comment: Showed only minor promise when eighth at Newbury (6f) but this race looks easier
runners_data.spotlight: 33-1 and showed only minor promise before weakening into eighth at Newbury (6f, good) a fortnight ago; this race looks easier, though, and he ought to have learnt from that experience.

runners_data.name: Ariane Sky
runners_data.comment: Displayed clear promise on both starts (5.7f/6f) but needs improvement for this new trip
runners_data.spotlight: Displayed clear promise on both starts, more recently when keeping-on fifth at Chepstow (6f, good to soft) nine days ago, but needs improvement for this longer trip.

races.name: Linton Electrical Contractors 50th Anniversary Handicap

runners_data.name: Vidmiyr
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist who thrived when getting a clear run at Doncaster and should benefit from guaranteed pace here
runners_data.spotlight: Denied clear run when placed off today's mark on this month's handicap debut at Doncaster (1m, good to firm) and did not need to improve to make all at skinny odds in 7f course maiden (good) 11 days ago; obvious contender.

runners_data.name: Velvet Rhythm
runners_data.note: Prominent runner in excellent form with two wins from two handicap starts, though facing 3lb rise
runners_data.comment: Narrow winner at Catterick (7f) nine days ago and now 2-2 in handicaps; respected
runners_data.spotlight: Kept on well to prevail by a head against her own sex at Catterick (7f, good) nine days ago and now 2-2 in handicaps; another 3lb higher over a slightly longer trip but is probably still improving; has big role to play.

runners_data.name: Berkshire Boom
runners_data.note: Classy type returning from 289-day absence, likely needs this run despite winning form at Chester
runners_data.comment: 7f 2yo maiden winner; made just a satisfactory seasonal/handicap debut this month
runners_data.spotlight: Absent 289 days after winning Chester maiden (7f, good) last summer and made no more than a respectable seasonal/handicap debut when midfield at Windsor (1m, good to firm) this month; needs that recent outing to have brought him on.

runners_data.name: Get Outta Here
runners_data.note: Prominent runner showing improvement last time but form difficult to assess against weak opposition
runners_data.comment: Placed behind 1-12 winner in 8.5f Epsom novice last month; back in trip for handicap debut
runners_data.spotlight: Appeared to display improvement when third of nine behind 1-12 favourite at Epsom (8.5f, good) last month, on third start; that form is quite tricky to weigh up but the running-on fourth has done well in the meantime; drops back in trip for handicap debut; remains unexposed.

runners_data.name: Raging Raj
runners_data.note: Natural front-runner with proven AW form, most race-fit but also most exposed in this field
runners_data.comment: The most exposed runner in the line-up but sure to appreciate this ease in grade
runners_data.spotlight: Won two AW nurseries in November (1m/7f) and began this campaign with two respectable runs in competitive 1m turf handicaps; the most exposed runner in the line-up but sure to appreciate this ease in grade.

runners_data.name: Accademia
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning from 213-day layoff, hard to fancy despite lightweight after long absence
runners_data.comment: Absent since fourth in AW novice in October but open to improvement in handicaps this year
runners_data.spotlight: Posted most encouraging of three qualifying runs when keeping-on fourth at Kempton (7f, AW) in October; has fitness to prove after seven-month absence but should have more improvement to come in handicaps at some stage this season.

races.paceDynamic: Raging Raj will make the early running with Velvet Rhythm and Berkshire Boom tracking close behind, creating a sustainable but not breakneck gallop over this 7½f trip. The presence of three prominent runners means the pace will be honest without being suicidal, allowing the race to develop into a proper staying test in the final two furlongs. With only six runners and no confirmed hold-up specialists other than Vidmiyr and Accademia, the race will lack the sustained pressure that typically burns off front-runners. This pace scenario strongly favours prominent runners who can travel kindly in the slipstream and hold-up horses with a turn of foot.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Gallop Scenario
scenarios.trigger: If Raging Raj maintains a strong tempo throughout with Velvet Rhythm and Berkshire Boom tracking close
scenarios.body: The honest pace will set up perfectly for hold-up horses with finishing kicks to strike late. Vidmiyr and Get Outta Here can benefit from the guaranteed pace and strong gallop.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominance
scenarios.trigger: If Raging Raj gets an easy lead and the pace becomes pedestrian early
scenarios.body: The lack of sustained pressure will allow the leader to dictate and kick clear when ready. Raging Raj's proven front-running ability and fitness edge become decisive advantages.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Battle Royal
scenarios.trigger: If all three prominent runners (Raging Raj, Velvet Rhythm, Berkshire Boom) engage in a speed duel
scenarios.body: The increased pace will tire the leaders and set up the race perfectly for late-closing types. Vidmiyr's hold-up style becomes a major tactical advantage in a truly-run race.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Fitness Tells
scenarios.trigger: If returning horses Berkshire Boom and Accademia show signs of rustiness or lack of match sharpness
scenarios.body: The race becomes a straight fight between the recently active horses with fitness on their side. Recent form and race-readiness become the determining factors over pure ability.

watchPoints.text: Watch for Berkshire Boom's fitness levels after 289 days off - any signs of blowing or weakening late indicate rustiness
Monitor if Raging Raj gets an uncontested lead early - could prove decisive if allowed to dictate fractions
Observe Vidmiyr's early positioning - needs to be handy enough to get a clear run in small field
Check Velvet Rhythm's jumping from the gates - prominent style depends on securing good early position
Watch Pat Cosgrave's tactics on Raging Raj - whether he goes forward immediately or tries to sit closer

races.name: Drain Detectives No.1 For Drains Apprentice Handicap

runners_data.name: Twilight Jet
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with proven course form who should get an easy lead given the field composition
runners_data.spotlight: Ex-Irish 7yo who had a much higher mark this time last year; well backed all day and on course when winning over C&D 12 days ago, and there's every chance he can defy a 3lb rise under Ashley Lewis, who has plenty of experience for his 3lb claim in this company.

runners_data.name: Mission Command
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning to 6f after mile racing, with pulling tendencies that could compromise positioning
runners_data.comment: Running over further of late; risks involved in a first-time visor dropped back to 6f
runners_data.spotlight: Has been running over further of late, looking to have no problem with 1m last month; pulled hard when below par last time and there are risks involved now first-time visored (has worn cheekpieces twice) dropped back to sprinting.

runners_data.name: Invincible Speed
runners_data.note: Consistent closer returning from 47-day break with strong course record over this distance
runners_data.comment: No obvious reason why he won't go well, back over an easier 6f, after a short break
runners_data.spotlight: Consistent gelding who's usually ridden from off the pace; no obvious reason why he won't go well once more, back over an easier 6f, returning from a short break.

runners_data.name: Woolridge
runners_data.note: Hold-up style with aggressive tactical switch recently, benefits from significant weight concessions
runners_data.comment: Best effort for this yard when back at 6f on Tapeta last time; now needs to build on it
runners_data.spotlight: Ex-Irish maiden who ran his best race for this yard, back up to 6f and under more aggressive tactics, on Newcastle Tapeta last time; now needs to build on it on just his third run on turf.

runners_data.name: The Bitter Moose
runners_data.note: Back-end runner better over 7f who may struggle if the pace doesn't develop sufficiently
runners_data.comment: Didn't get the breaks back down to 6f last time; capable of going well off this mark
runners_data.spotlight: Has done his winning, and a lot of his racing, over 7f; didn't get the breaks back down to 6f last time following a fair AW comeback, and he's capable of going well off this mark.

runners_data.name: Lahina Bay
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning from 126-day layoff with seasonal pattern concerns despite past course success
runners_data.comment: Likely to come on for the run and she might need a bit more help from the handicapper
runners_data.spotlight: Most wins have come in the second half of the year and always after a recent outing; returns from four months off and she might need a bit more help from the handicapper.

races.paceDynamic: Twilight Jet and Lahina Bay are the only pace-setting options, but Lahina Bay returns from 126 days off which leaves Twilight Jet as the clear pace angle. With Mission Command, Invincible Speed, The Bitter Moose and Woolridge all preferring to be held up, this creates a very sustainable tempo with minimal early pressure. The modest early gallop will allow the hold-up horses to get into contention, but the lack of genuine pace pressure means those who can travel kindly and kick from prominent positions will have a clear tactical advantage over those needing a truly-run race.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustainable Pace Favours Leaders
scenarios.trigger: If Twilight Jet sets uncontested fractions with Lahina Bay struggling fresh
scenarios.body: The gentle tempo allows prominent racers to conserve energy and kick clear when the hold-up horses are still gathering momentum. Twilight Jet's proven course form and recent win make him perfectly placed to exploit this tactical scenario.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Get Perfect Setup
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely in the middle sections
scenarios.body: The crawling gallop allows the closers to position perfectly and unleash their finishing kicks simultaneously in a bunched finale. Invincible Speed's consistency and Mission Command's recent mile form suggest they can time their challenges best.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Woolridge Capitalizes On Class Drop
scenarios.trigger: If the ex-Irish maiden can translate his Newcastle Tapeta improvement to turf
scenarios.body: His much lower official rating gives him a significant weight advantage while his recent tactical switch to more aggressive racing suits this pace setup. The 6f return from 5f sprinting provides the perfect distance compromise for his finishing kick.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Lahina Bay Overcomes Absence
scenarios.trigger: If the 6yo mare can reproduce her second-half seasonal pattern despite the layoff
scenarios.body: Her prominent style would be ideally suited if she can find her rhythm early, but the 126-day break creates serious fitness doubts. The weight concession helps but may not be enough to overcome the conditioning deficit.

watchPoints.text: Twilight Jet getting too soft a lead early as the hold-up horses may not close the gap in time
Mission Command pulling hard in the early stages which would negate his hold-up style advantages
Lahina Bay showing signs of ring-rustiness in the preliminaries after her lengthy absence
The pace through the first two furlongs as it will determine whether closers get their preferred strong gallop
Woolridge's positioning as his recent tactical switch to more prominent racing could be key
